expectations.text: Returns a Socratic prompt, not an actual cold email
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is one Socratic prompt; no email drafted.

expectations.text: Has theory + framework + application pointing back at the product
expectations.evidence: Theory (what earns a reply), framework (named), tradeoff move, then 'Now apply ... write a cold email for [my B2B SaaS product]'.

expectations.text: Names at least one real copywriting framework
expectations.evidence: Names PAS (Problem·Agitate·Solve), AIDA, give-value/trigger-event, one-CTA rule.

expectations.text: Leaves a bracketed placeholder rather than inventing details
expectations.evidence: Explicit [my B2B SaaS product], [buyer persona], [type of company], [pain or trigger event], [one proof point] plus a 'fill in before you run it' note.

expectations.text: Reads as a question-driven prompt, not an instruction with a '?'
expectations.evidence: Opens with genuine questions separating the levers before any directive.
